title: CBIT + TMS
design: Randomized parallel three-arm masked intervention, all arms CBIT

reported_tst_change.caution: Single unlabeled row despite five described contrasts; timepoint/task condition cannot be assigned confidently.

endpoint_cautions: Neural units eta squared and SD conflict with description promising Cohen d.
Safety and feasibility secondary here but abstract calls primary.
No clinical baseline metrics supplied in baseline module.
claim_not_supported: Added clinical benefit, comparative safety or mature-adult effect reconstructed from ambiguous registry fields.
retrieval_status: Current official aggregate API record; no participant records.

title: Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation in the treatment of Tourette's Disorder: effectiveness and tolerability
design: Uncontrolled open-label adult rTMS study; retrospective registration relative to first enrollment.
population: Adults with TS, reported age bands 19–34 and 35–59; mature adults included but severe-persistent subgroup coverage not established.

reported_ygtss.unit_caution: Described as total/global YGTSS; do not relabel a 0–50 tic-only score.

adverse_events: 3/9 reported headache and 1/9 drowsiness; one withdrew after five sessions due to headache. No serious events reported in this very small sample.
uncertainty: No comparator, completer analysis, multiple subdomains, no verified precision or independent-rater masking. English summary calls 36.7 disease duration; Portuguese says mean age. Intervention section and summary disagree on pulse count. No results-posting timestamp or in-window history verified.
claim_supported: Uncontrolled total/global symptom change failed reported significance; retain negative endpoint and headache withdrawal.
claim_not_supported: Proof of efficacy, proof of no benefit, generalized safety, causal anxiety–tic relation or new October result.
retrieval_status: Official bilingual registry summary read; no patient file/full paper used.
next_verification_task: Resolve original outcome scale, translation and intervention discrepancies before pooling; no outreach authorized.
